chapter_seo_title: The Grand Xia Emperor Personally Commands the Immortal Fortunes Assembly: A New Era of Conflict Begins
chapter_meta_description: The Grand Xia Emperor, fearing a cosmic tribulation, personally decrees that all major powers send their best disciples to a high-stakes Immortal Fortunes Assembly. The fate of the realm hangs in the balance.
og_title: The Emperor Awakens: A Cosmic Showdown is Ordered!
og_description: The Grand Xia Emperor pulls the trigger on a legendary tournament. Every elite disciple must attend. The future of the Three Realms will be decided.
twitter_title: The Emperor is anxious! He's hosting the biggest ever Immortal Fortunes Assembly.
twitter_description: The Grand Xia Emperor fears a coming tribulation, and he personally decrees that all the realm's top geniuses must compete in the next Immortal Fortunes Assembly.

lore_anchors.definition: The fundamental cosmic mechanism of the Three Realms that recycles souls between different lifeforms. It collapsed decades ago in the novel, causing immense upheaval.
A metaphysical concept of fate, fortune, and destiny. In Xianxia, convergence of Qi Yun around a person or event makes them more likely to gain power and become historical heroes.
The supreme natural law governing the universe. Cultivators who grasp a Heavenly Dao are among the most powerful beings in the Three Realms.
A triennial tournament for Wanxiang Adepts held by the Grand Xia Dynasty, where winners receive treasures and a chance to be recognized by supreme powers.
The absolute sovereign over the entire Grand Xia major world. He hails from the primordial imperial clan and commands immense personal power and authority.
